title: AI Workflow Automation
description: Techlio automates document-heavy and back-office workflows with AI, deterministic validation and human approval on exceptions.
h1: Automate the workflow, *keep a person on the exceptions.*
intro: Most operational work is the same handful of steps repeated thousands of times. We automate those steps with AI where judgment is needed, plain rules where it is not, and an approver for anything unusual.
caption: An invoice arrives by email, is classified, extracted, validated against the purchase order, approved if needed, posted to the ERP and logged.
offerIntro: Four stages, in order. Each one ends with something you can inspect.

offerings.title: Map the workflow
offerings.text: We sit with the people doing the work, record volumes and error rates, and capture a baseline so the saving can be measured later.

offerings.title: Design the checks
offerings.text: For each step we decide what AI does, what rules do and where a person approves. Validation is designed before any model is chosen.

offerings.title: Build and integrate
offerings.text: The automation is connected to your inbox, ERP, CRM and messaging tools, and tested on your real documents and edge cases.

offerings.title: Go live and measure
offerings.text: We run alongside the manual process first, then switch over. Hours saved and exception rates are reported every week.

whyTitle: Why teams trust it with real work

why.title: Rules where rules work
why.text: Totals, matches and thresholds are checked with deterministic code. Models are used for reading and judgment, not arithmetic.

why.title: Exceptions, not rework
why.text: Approvers see only what needs them, with the source document and the reason next to the decision.

why.title: Savings on the record
why.text: Every run is logged against the baseline, so the business case is a report rather than a claim.

closeTitle: Which workflow costs your team the most hours?
closeText: Bring one process to the scoping call. We will tell you what can be automated, what should not be, and what it would take.

card.lead: Take the repetitive work off your team.
card.text: We map the workflows that eat your operators’ hours, then automate them with checks at every step and a person on the exceptions.

faqs.question: Which workflows are good candidates?
faqs.answer: Work that is frequent, follows rules most of the time, and moves data between systems: document processing, order and ticket handling, back-office reconciliation, reporting and follow-ups.

faqs.question: What happens when the automation is unsure?
faqs.answer: The case is routed to a person with the context already gathered. Their decision is recorded and used to improve the workflow.

faqs.question: Will this replace our staff?
faqs.answer: The aim is to remove repetitive hours so staff spend time on exceptions and customers. Most clients redeploy the time saved.

faqs.question: Which tools do you use?
faqs.answer: We choose per case: n8n for visual, maintainable workflows, custom code where volume or logic needs it, and language models for the steps that involve reading or writing.

faqs.question: How do we know it is working?
faqs.answer: Each workflow has logging, alerts on failure and a simple dashboard showing volume, exceptions and time saved.

answer: AI workflow automation uses software and language models to carry out repetitive, multi-step work such as processing invoices, routing requests or preparing reports, while a person handles the exceptions. Techlio maps the workflow with the people who run it, automates the routine steps with checks at each stage, and keeps a human approval point for anything unusual.
